title: Jellyfish drift
idea: a jellyfish drifts upward through dark water towards the light
style: documentary underwater, deep blue, soft highlights
subject: a translucent moon jellyfish with faint pink organs, tentacles trailing
setting: open ocean at twenty metres depth, dark below, bright surface above
light: caustic light patterns from the surface, blue falloff into darkness below, the jellyfish lit from above

beats.action: the jellyfish pulses once in the dark, tentacles trailing
beats.camera: slow drift upward from below, slight roll

beats.action: it pulses again and rises; tiny particles drift past
beats.camera: continue the drift, orbiting slightly to the left

beats.action: caustic light from the surface starts to ripple across its bell
a small school of silver fish passes in the background
beats.camera: rack focus briefly to the fish, then back

beats.action: the jellyfish reaches the bright water and glows; hold

physics: everything moves slowly with drag; the bell contracts then relaxes with a lag in the tentacles; bubbles rise; particles drift in the water column
